title: Men's Hiking Boots – Lightweight with Thick Sole
descriptionHtml:
The mountain doesn't care that your boots are "almost broken in"

Heavy boots that chafe after an hour turn the hike into a slog. And the thin walking shoes? They feel every stone.

The solution: thick sole, low weight – all season

Hiking boots with a thick, cushioning sole that takes the edge off rocky ground, yet light enough to forget on your feet. Built for daily walks, hiking and climbing – year-round, even in large sizes.

Features

  • Takes the edge off rocky ground – thick cushioning sole
  • Lightweight – far from classic heavy boots
  • Comfortable right away – no long break-in
  • For all seasons – hiking, walking, camping
  • Available in large sizes

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
